subj.label: zhang thang sag pa ye shes 'byung gnas (3870)

relations.zotero_refs: [ABYM2GP5]: 31, n. 33. Lineage of prāsaṅgika Madhyamaka shared by later Sa skya pa scholars: Pa tshab (ID:3868), Zhang Thang sag pa (ID:3870), Brom dBang phyug grags (ID:7538), Bla ma Prajahavajra, Slob dpon sTon tshul ba, Bla ma bDe ba'i lha, Jo btsun pa, Dbu ra ba, Prajñāśrī, Dharma shes rab, Bag ston Shes rab rin chen, rJe Punyasingha, Bag ston bSam bsang, Bag ston gzhon nu bsam gtan, and from him to both Red mda’ ba (ID:6756) and dMar ston (ID:6922); from the latter to Rong ston (ID:6005).
